sources.publisher: University of Bonn, Photogrammetry and Robotics Lab
sources.role: external physical ingestion pilot; not CRANE robot calibration
sources.citation: N. Trekel et al., Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Localization in Indoor Environments Under Substantial Static and Dynamic Scene Changes, IROS 2025.
limitations: Velocity commands are unstamped Twist messages; bag record times are not actuator application times.
Publisher header timestamps do not establish hardware acquisition clock synchronization.
Wheel odometry and reference poses require a declared frame relation before absolute residual comparison.
SICK TIM781S and RealSense D455 differ from VLP-16 and ZED 2i.
No repeated identical physical command trials or CRANE closed-loop runs are established.
